## 1800 - 1899

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01800">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1800 QRC - Quality radical change</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01800">

Quality Radical Change exceptions are related to the limits that are defined in the Quality Source Validations (Setup \> Source Analysis \> Gas/Liquid Quality) for both Gas and Liquid Sources. FLOWCAL will compare the specified sample values to the prior sample values. If the value changes by more than the limit that the user defines, then an exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01801">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1801 QRC - High relative density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01801">

FLOWCAL will compare the Relative Density on the current sample to the Relative Density on the prior sample. An exception will be generated if the Relative Density has increased by more than the limit defined in the Radical Change validation for Relative Density.

For example, the current sample has a Relative Density value of 0.6. The limit defined in Radical Change validation for Relative is 0.01. If the prior sample’s Relative Density is less than 0.59, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01802">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01802">

For example, the current sample has a Relative Density value of 0.6. The limit defined in Radical Change validation for Relative is 0.01. If the prior sample’s Relative Density is greater than 0.61, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01827">

FLOWCAL will compare the C2 - Ethane Mole Pct on the current sample to the C2 - Ethane Mole Pct on the prior sample. An exception will be generated if the C2 - Ethane Mole Pct has increased by more than the limit defined in the Radical Change validation for C2 - Ethane Mole Pct.

For example, the current sample has a C2 - Ethane Mole Pct value of 11. The limit defined in Radical Change validation for C2 - Ethane Mole Pct is 0.5. If the prior sample’s C2 - Ethane Mole Pct is less than 10.5, then this exception will be generated.

</div>
